subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy live under global messages.tts, Telegram channel config, or a narrower channel capability?
rationale: The source-level behavior is clear, but the requested fix adds public configuration and overlaps with active captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions, so automation should not choose the contract.

options.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Add a backward-compatible mode such as bundled/captioned versus separate, document it, and require Telegram tests plus live Telegram proof before implementation.

options.title: Standardize captioned delivery
options.body: Keep voice-with-caption as the supported Telegram default and document tagged/manual splitting plus overflow fallback instead of adding another config path.

options.title: Wait for captioned-final direction
options.body: Defer this decision until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 is merged, closed, or narrowed enough to show how separate delivery should coexist.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible mode such as bundled/captioned versus separate, document it, and require Telegram tests plus live Telegram proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across core TTS policy and Telegram delivery, which are the contract boundaries in question.
